scope: Standalone FP64 Rust execution of frozen R15 finite 40-state conservative row generators and supplied emission matrices. Financial parameter-to-generator construction remains Python input. This is not a continuum financial solution or production neuron adoption.
methods: Positive row-vector uniformization; simultaneous flux integration for expected repeated natural absorptions and killed-generator first-event probability; Bayesian READ/REFRESH; explicit reset into recovery preserving content; missing observation identity. No probability clipping or semigroup renormalization.
reference: Independent scipy.linalg.expm on supplied Q, killed Q and 41-state flux augmentations; no project propagation methods imported.
cases: 8 frozen declared models (4 HX parameterized and 4 unconstrained finite rate/reset models) x 8 initial states, 12 causal operations per case. New random dense priors are generated only after source freeze. Every case also has cold-process state round-trip and semigroup check.
failure_policy: Preserve all diagnostic and confirmation records. Any gate failure remains failed; a changed source requires a new freeze and new namespace.
limits: No task quality or core D-B gain
No Q24, FP32, GPU, energy, power-loss or production lifecycle qualification
The truncation bound addresses exact arithmetic, not a uniform FP64 roundoff proof; unrepresentable observation evidence and propagation clocks are rejected
